full_title: The Great Wizard — Grand Archmage & Wise Mentor of Pythonia

demographics.proportions: 5.5 to 6.2 heads tall (including tall pointed wizard hat), dignified slightly stooped warm sage posture
demographics.build: Slender-sturdy elder sage draped in voluminous layered robes

facial_features.face_shape: Kind, elongated oval elder face with gentle laugh lines and soft crow's feet
facial_features.skin_tone: Warm fair peach skin with soft rosy blush on cheeks and nose

hair.style: Long wavy silver-white locks cascading from under hat onto shoulders

beard_and_mustache.style: Full layered flowing beard reaching mid-chest with soft wavy locks, paired with a full drooping mustache curving warmly over a gentle smile

eyes.shape: Warm, expressive rounded eyes with friendly arched white eyebrows
eyes.highlights: Crisp white catchlight reflections conveying wisdom and kindness

facial_features.nose_and_mouth: Prominent rounded friendly nose, gentle welcoming smile

grand_archmage_robes.name: Grand Archmage Celestial Robes (Canonical Default)
grand_archmage_robes.description: The Wizard's iconic indigo, plum, and lavender celestial robes adorned with crescent moons, stars, and golden scrollwork

hat.style: Tall pointed wide-brimmed wizard hat with tip curving gently to his right (viewer's left)
hat.embellishments: Embroidered golden crescent moon and scattered four-pointed/five-pointed gold stars on crown
hat.hatband: Wide rose-plum / violet band (Hex: #7C4B7D) with wavy golden chevron embroidery and gold piping

shoulder_mantle.color: Deep royal purple / plum mantle (Hex: #5A3C7E) with flared collar points
shoulder_mantle.trim: Wide rose-plum/mauve border (Hex: #9E688F) with swirling golden scrollwork and double gold trim lines
shoulder_mantle.motifs: Golden crescent moon and small stars embroidered on right shoulder

outer_robe.color: Twilight slate-blue flowing over-robe (Hex: #4A6B9C), open down the front with deep purple lining and wide bell sleeves
outer_robe.trim: Vertical front edges and wide sleeve cuffs bordered in mauve/rose-plum (Hex: #9E688F) with continuous golden wave-scroll embroidery
outer_robe.skirt_motifs: Lower right skirt panel embellished with a golden crescent moon, stars, and delicate golden botanical/celestial hem filigree

inner_robe.details: Golden geometric diamond sigil embroidered on upper chest and ornate golden crown-like filigree scrollwork along lower hem

belt_sash.detail: Twin hanging braided cords ending in golden multi-strand tassels at right hip

staff.type: Tall wooden Arcane Crystal Staff held in left hand
staff.shaft: Straight rustic brown hardwood shaft transitioning at upper neck into a twisted double-helix spiral wood cradle (Hex: #7E5A38)
staff.crystal: Four claw-like wooden/silvery prongs cradling a large, faceted, glowing cyan-ice blue mana crystal (Hex: #42D4FF to #8CF0FF)

traveling_sage_cloak.name: Traveling Sage Cloak
traveling_sage_cloak.description: Practical road-travel variant retaining the pointed indigo moon-and-star hat, flowing slate-blue traveling cloak over lavender tunic, braided tassel belt, and crystal staff

scholar_study_robes.name: Library & Study Robes
scholar_study_robes.description: Hatless indoors variant showing full wavy silver-white hair, wearing the lavender under-tunic, purple embroidered shoulder mantle, and braided tassel cord while reading or teaching Kai

art_style_dna.primary_style: Hand-drawn fantasy storybook illustration, Studio Ghibli meets classic fairytale watercolor and ink aesthetic (harmonious with Hero Kai)
art_style_dna.line_art: Clean warm-sepia and dark charcoal ink linework with organic hand-drawn lineweight variation
art_style_dna.shading_technique: Soft watercolor and gouache washes with gentle color gradients and subtle vintage parchment grain
art_style_dna.color_palette: Twilight slate-blues (#4A6B9C), royal purples (#5A3C7E), mauve-plum trims (#9E688F), lavender-periwinkle (#7A74A8), antique gold embroidery (#D4AF37), glowing cyan crystal (#42D4FF)
art_style_dna.atmosphere: Wise, whimsical, mystical, warm, grandfatherly, adventurous

do: Always include the tall indigo pointed hat with rose-plum chevron band and golden crescent moon & stars (unless indoors study variant)
Always render his long thick flowing silver-white beard and drooping mustache with warm blue eyes
Always feature the layered indigo/blue outer robe over lavender inner tunic with mauve/rose-plum gold-scrollwork borders
Always include the braided golden-brown rope belt with twin hanging tassels on his right hip
Always render the wooden staff with its twisted spiral neck cradling a faceted glowing cyan-blue crystal
Maintain the exact hand-drawn ink and watercolor storybook art style matching Hero Kai
dont: Do NOT render in photorealistic 3D CGI, plastic Unreal Engine style, or dark grimdark necromancer aesthetics
Do NOT change the crystal staff orb to a fiery red skull, plain wooden stick, or metallic scepter — keep the faceted cyan-blue crystal in twisted wood prongs
Do NOT replace his blue-and-purple celestial robes with plain grey Gandalf robes or modern suits
Do NOT omit the golden crescent moon and star embroidery on hat and robe trim
Do NOT include screenshot artifacts, horizontal dashed crop lines, or rough cutout backgrounds

key_events: ENV_R00: Greets Hero Kai upon arrival from the Virtual City glitch vortex.
ENV_R01: Guides Kai through Spell 1 VOICE (print()) in Silent Village and directs him toward Loom Forest.
ENV_R05: Teaches Spell 5 VAULT (gold = 100) and gifts Kai the silver Spatial Dimensional Pocket.
ENV_R05A: Teaches Spell 6 MULTI-VAULT (hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10) inside the Echoing Cavern, then bids Kai farewell beneath the Silver-Leafed Tree by dissolving into glowing emerald digital code.
